queries.query: Has any published work scheduled entanglement distribution at a quantum switch or hub that serves two bipartite requests sharing one user (for example A–B and A–C), where the hub chooses the swap partner from the age of the stored link, minimizes the age of entanglement under a memory cutoff, and adds a long-run delivery-rate floor and an attempt budget? Has this been studied for underwater optical quantum links?
("quantum switch" OR "underwater optical quantum communication") AND ("entanglement distribution" OR "entanglement swapping" OR "age of entanglement" OR "memory cutoff")
("quantum switch" OR hub OR "stored link") AND ("memory cutoff" OR "hub chooses" OR "swap partner")

selection.criterion: Include a primary study that schedules entanglement distribution at a quantum switch or hub for two bipartite requests sharing one user, with swap-partner selection based on stored-link age and age-of-entanglement minimization subject to a memory cutoff, a long-run delivery-rate floor, and an attempt budget.
